review.posthog_relevance: Adds pagination and status indicators to the warehouse schema management form, improving warehouse admin usability and maintainability.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H4 together implement pagination and status indicators for warehouse schema management. P1.F1.H1 adds the paginated table and status indicators, while P1.F2.H4 adds pagination and relevant tests. This is a substantive, bounded improvement to warehouse admin usability and maintainability.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of pagination and the complete change to the admin view, nor does it include the complete test setup. This limits the ability to fully assess the implementation and relevant checks.
